text.en: Multiresolution hash encoding is row 20 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Vision area.
text.zh: Multiresolution hash encoding 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 20 行，所属领域为“视觉”。

text.en: The annual table associates Multiresolution hash encoding with “Instant Neural Graphics Primitives with a Multiresolution Hash Encoding”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Multiresolution hash encoding 与论文《Instant Neural Graphics Primitives with a Multiresolution Hash Encoding》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Thomas Muller, Alexander Keller”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Thomas Muller（官方页拼写）、Alexander Keller（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Thomas Muller, Alexander Keller”。
